name: practice-viriditas
description: Guide viriditas (greening power) meditation and philosophy practice. Covers the concept of viriditas as divine life force, structured meditation protocol, seasonal attunement, and integration with Hildegardian health and spiritual practice. Use when practicing Hildegardian contemplative spirituality, feeling disconnected from seasonal rhythms, experiencing spiritual dryness or lack of vitality, seeking a meditation that integrates body and earth, or deepening understanding of Hildegard's ecological theology.
